currency.basis: Capture dates (2020-06-14 asset; 2020 homepage; 2020-08-06 rebranding page) fall within the bank's last brand period (Ижкомбанк rebranded to «Датабанк» in 2019, bank closed 2019-2020); the record title «Датабанк» matches this period. No later official presentation exists.

identity.basis: Asset comes from the bank's own domain (izhcombank.ru) as archived by the Wayback Machine; the same И-swoosh mark appears in the site header inline logo and in the full wordmark logo data_logo.svg from the same domain.

assessment.independenceRationale: All primary observations derive from one publication domain (the bank's official site, archived); the rebranding page, homepage header and asset files are distinct official pages of that one source, and the Wayback Machine provides the dated capture. No independent third-party source was additionally consulted for the mark's design.

variant.basis: Standalone mark variant (blue circle + emblem, no lettering) is the site's own icon-size asset (logo-general.svg, 'logo-general@1x'); the blue #4A90E2 differs from the header wordmark blue #004790 — both are official same-period variants; suitability decision belongs to candidate preparation.

candidate.detailsJudgement: All source contours survive: circle boundary, the two swoosh strokes, the small detached tail detail at right, and the transparent counter. The transparent hole correctly shows white/#121212 through the final render. No clipping, no lost details.
candidate.proportionsJudgement: The near-square 20x21 emblem fills the catalog 162px icon area with comfortable margins on the 240px canvas; it is recognizable at 24/32/48 px diagnostics on both themes, with adequate stroke weight and contrast. No stretching; no circle mask needed since the emblem is already circular.
candidate.rationale: First addition of the bank's own standalone mark: the official logo-general.svg from izhcombank.ru (Wayback capture 2020-06-14), the final brand period of the record (Ижкомбанк rebranded to «Датабанк» in 2019; bank closed 2019-2020). The mark is a self-contained original-vector emblem — blue #4A90E2 circle with a transparent swoosh-shaped counter — with no accompanying lettering, matching the record title «Датабанк» period. It fits a square cell and remains legible on both themes.
candidate.role: Standalone bank emblem (site icon-size asset 'logo-general@1x'); the mark itself, not a full lockup.
transforms: No geometric transformation: the emblem is used as-is in its 20x21 viewBox; only uniform authoring serialization changed.

SVGO 4.1.0 with the repository svgo.config.mjs (config sha256 f2a406e05dd8849e35cd5d2ce96862b6e160b135135064ceafd64efd126f477e): 1953 bytes working -> 1014 bytes optimized (sha256 479705866ab361c9b017a01b2b1e95066e12acac662e01563cae9ee082ae68d0); selected because it is smaller, visually faithful (rsvg-convert comparison max channel difference <= 8/255 on both themes, antialiasing only), and converter-compatible in the pinned Desktop export.

No backing added: the source is a suitable transparent standalone mark (transparent corners only; the swoosh counter is an intentional transparent hole showing the theme background), so transparency is preserved per the background/fit policy.
candidate.variant: Blue standalone circle variant from the bank's own site; the header wordmark used #004790 and the popup lockup a grey #CCCCCC monochrome — this blue circle asset is the site's own standalone variant from the same period.
candidate.visibleDiffExplanation: First addition: the frozen base has no icon.svg for this record (confirmed absent), so the visible difference is absence to a real, legible official mark.

proposals.reason: Found an original-vector standalone bank mark from the bank's own site (archived): izhcombank.ru/images/logo-general.svg, a self-contained SVG (blue #4A90E2 circular mark with the И-swoosh emblem, viewBox 0 0 20 21). Captured by the Wayback Machine on 2020-06-14, within the final brand period of the bank. The bank is defunct (license revoked 2019; site offline today), so archived official assets are the correct dated source. The full wordmark logo also exists as an official vector (images/popup/data_logo.svg, grey #CCCCCC monochrome) but carries accompanying lettering and is not the standalone-mark candidate.

sourceCandidate.rationale: Original vector (self-contained single-path SVG, fill #4A90E2, viewBox 0 0 20 21) of the standalone bank emblem, no accompanying text, from the bank's official site as archived 2020-06-14 (Wayback replay https://web.archive.org/web/20200614234134id_/https://izhcombank.ru/images/logo-general.svg); body sha256 79b98e962fc41940567500bfea8a0fa4e1494b73b415f7437c0e38331b2df68d.

sources.observation: Official site unreachable: HTTPS transfer failed (connection error), consistent with the bank's closure (license revoked 2019).

Archived homepage (2020-01-01): header logo is an inline SVG (viewBox 0 0 207.98 48, colors #004790/#7c7d7d/#9e9fa0) combining the mark with the wordmark; no standalone logo file referenced. source-material extraction blocked: external SVG style context / duplicate vector IDs.
Official rebranding page (archived 2020-08-06): announces ПАО «Ижкомбанк» rebranding to «Датабанк», confirming the record's title/brand period.

Wayback CDX index of site assets; located original SVG assets: images/logo-general.svg (20200614232237), images/popup/data_logo.svg (20200306073005), images/popup/izhkom_logo.svg (20200306073013, replay 404), images/logo.svg (20180214113639, pre-rebrand full logo).

Official full logo SVG (250x55, grey #CCCCCC monochrome variant): circular И-swoosh mark + «ижкомбанк» wordmark. Original vector, but contains accompanying lettering; not suitable as a standalone catalog mark.

Standalone bank mark as an original self-contained SVG (20x21, single path, fill #4A90E2): blue circle with the И-swoosh emblem, no lettering. Official site asset from the final brand period (capture 2020-06-14). Rendered locally via rsvg-convert and visually confirmed as the standalone emblem.
